ways.label: Round trip: up Avalanche Peak Track/Route, down Scotts Route/Track
evidence: You have the option of tramping both routes for a round trip or going up and down the same route.
If doing the round trip, we recommend you start with the Avalanche Peak Track, which begins just behind the visitor centre.
From Arthur's Pass Visitor Centre follow the bush edge northwards to pick up the start of the track, signposted before the Glasgow Bridge over Avalanche Creek (elevation 737 m).
The track meets the road about 700 m west from the Arthur’s Pass Visitor Centre, the track then continues across the road and ends at the Punchbowl car park.

ways.label: Up and down return trip via Scotts Track/Route

start.name: Scotts Track start by the Punchbowl carpark on SH73

evidence: For those intending to go up and down the same way, we recommend Scotts Track/Route.
Scotts Track is signposted on the main road, about 700 m west of the Arthur’s Pass Visitor Centre.
The track start is 30 m from the Punchbowl carpark.
Take note of the route up, to enable you to return the same way.

doubts: The page calls Option 1 a 'round trip', so recorded as a loop from the visitor centre, but the descent ends at the Punchbowl car park about 700 m west of the visitor centre and the text says the highway is unsafe to walk on, so the loop does not close on foot as described. No feature is where the Avalanche Peak Track starts behind the visitor centre, so the start ref is null. F2 (Scotts Track meets West Coast Road/SH73) is used for the Scotts Track road end and Punchbowl car park; the car park is just across the road from where the track meets the road, so it may not be exactly F2. DOC's time ('3-4 hr to summit') and distance ('2.5 km ... one way') are to the summit, not for either full way, so left null. Going up and down the Avalanche Peak Track is also allowed but not described as its own option.
